name: ruyix
description: Ruyix — the agent OS, as you wish. Built on DSH (DeepSeek Harness); its core is customization: an agent reshapes the desktop, the apps and the workflows for you. core/ runs on dsh (the shell, the workbench, the connections, the agents, the boards, the box's view), box/ is the image a nookbox box runs, tools/ installs from source.
